title: [Hiring] Commission-based BD / AI implementation consultants + unpaid portfolio AI engineers (water utilities, pre-revenue, remote)
text: Hi everyone, I’m Shantel Jones, solo founder of Meridian AI LLC in Tempe, Arizona (remote, US time zones). We’re pre-revenue, with no customers yet. We build workflow software for small water utilities and irrigation districts: who owns the follow-up after an alert, and what proves it’s done. I’m looking for two kinds of help, and I want to be upfront about how each is paid. Commission-based business development and AI implementation consulting. This is for people who can find and close clients, and/or investigate a company’s workflows and advise on how AI (including automation tools like n8n) would actually get used there. Any commission would be a share of cash Meridian actually collects, with the percentage and terms agreed in writing before any work starts. Because we don’t have revenue yet, I can’t promise income, deals, or a timeline. If that uncertainty isn’t a fit, please skip this one. Unpaid, flexible, portfolio-building AI engineering work. All of this uses fictional or public data (for example public water-system records), not customer data. We’d agree attribution and licensing up front, and we’d scope one clear deliverable with a stopping point. The work is yours to show. To apply, use this interest form: docs.google.com Meridian Project Interest - November 2026 About Meridian Meridian AI LLC is developing a software prototype alongside founder-led advisory and implementation services. title: [HIRING] Freelancer for Airtable Workflow | Remote
text: Background: I’m opening a Gumroad store soon and i want to export sales data from Gumroad to Airtable for a little bit of flexibility when following up with customers. Role : Looking for freelancers to help with sending data from Gumroad to my Airtable table. Data I’m looking to collect include email addresses, transaction date, transaction amount, product id, etc. Previously worked with a freelancer before who setup a workflow that scammed me into thinking the automation worked, it in fact did not work. Either way, I’m starting from scratch again and would love to work with a freelancer who can get this done quickly. I don’t imagine this workflow being difficult. But if it is, I’d love to hear an easier version of this workflow that gives me the same result (so if anyone knows a better way to run this workflow, feel free to let me know via the Airtable form in the “Tell me about yourself” section).
